## Current status

The [Backend Support Matrix](backend-support.qmd) is the detailed source for
implementation state, exercised evidence, and current limits. The
PDK/Component/SCGSim authority split and public notebook ownership were accepted
on 2026-08-16; this page records priorities rather than repeating capability
status.

## Near term

The reviewed Human-assigned minimal runtime stabilization and first stable
`main` delivery are complete. The documentation-only 1.0.1 maintenance
release uses confirmed native Askr presentation and focuses on:

1. Four reader-facing Areas with floating Pages navigation and a Sections TOC.
2. Current stable, development and retained historical sites with exact content
   and presentation identities, preserving existing page URLs.
3. Develop-to-main promotion, required checks and actual Pages deployment of the
   reviewed maintenance release.

Native presentation is accepted and maintenance release delivery is
authorized. Instructional content redesign remains separate future work;
this release does not accept the complete curriculum. It adds no solver
family, scientific criterion, runtime API or public notebook authority.
